message:
Per #18472: apply review notes for JSON path quoting

## Summary
This PR applies the follow-up noted in #18472 / the SQL generation review thread and brings the JSON path extraction branch back in line with the previously approved PostgreSQL query-shape.

## Context
In the review on #18472, the agreed direction was to keep JSON path rendering consistent with the existing `#>>'{...}'` form used throughout the generator logic, rather than introducing a separate escaped intermediate for the path segment. This change is just the mechanical implementation of that sign-off in the abstract query generator.

## What changed
- remove the temporary `pathKey` assignment
- render the JSON path inline in the `#>>'{...}'` expression again
- keep the surrounding identifier quoting behavior unchanged

## Why
This is a narrow follow-up to the earlier approval, mainly to preserve the expected SQL output shape and avoid adding an extra escaping/codepath split in this hot path. The broader approach was already discussed and settled in the earlier thread, so this PR is only applying those review notes rather than revisiting the design.

## Notes
- scoped to the PostgreSQL JSON path generation branch
- no behavioral changes intended outside restoring the approved SQL rendering form
